text:
elaine: Planning a DR rehearsal: rotate TLS certs for etcd endpoints + run a cold snapshot restore test against a staging copy of cluster 'prov-east-2' next Wed 03:00 UTC (120m window). Purpose: verify cert rotation automation + snapshot restore latency under load.

elaine: Impact: no production etcd will be touched. We'll operate on staging clones, but routing tests will briefly exercise cross-region snapshot downloads (~30s per restore). Expect small inter-region egress and a few synthetic API spikes in staging only.

simon: Sounds good. Confirm no live clusters are targeted and secrets/KMS unaffected?

elaine: Confirmed: staging-only. KMS access uses test keys and will not hit production HSM. We'll still coordinate security for cert telemetry.

devan: Ops checklist: run cert-rotate on staging control-plane, then take etcd-snapshot, then simulate restore on a cold node. Cohorts: 2 parallel restores to measure bandwidth. Stagger starts by 10m. Abort if restore time > 20m or snapshot checksum mismatch.

olga: Can we estimate egress? two restores ~100GB each => ~200GB outbound to restore region, cost estimate ~ $40-70. Call out in comms.

mark: SRE: I'll run a restore-pressure canary and measure API latencies. If p95 > 500ms for the staging control-plane during the restore we pause. Also watch for unexpected leader elections.

tina: Support: we'll post a short note on internal status and notify any customers running staged load tests. No external customer comms needed since this is staging-only.

ops-bot: Ticket #INC-4620 created: etcd cert+snapshot-dr-rehearsal. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/ops/runbooks/etcd-dr-rehearsal. Notifying: eng-infra-oncall.

devan: Runbook snippet:
```
cert-rotate --cluster prov-east-2-staging --target etcd --dry-run false
etcdctl snapshot save /tmp/snap-$(date +%s).db
restore-node --snapshot /tmp/snap-*.db --verify-checksum --parallel 2
metrics-verify --checks snapshot-time,p95-api,leader-elections
```

elaine: Final ack list: simon (security), mark (sre), devan (ops), olga (finance for cost tag). Any objections?

simon: ACK (security). I'll monitor cert telemetry.

mark: ACK (sre). I'll own the canary and be on-call for the window.

olga: ACK (finance). Cost tag added to ticket.

deven: ACK (ops). Stagger and automation ready.

ops-bot: Ticket #INC-4620 state -> scheduled.

elaine: Thanks all. I'll post preflight results 1h before and a short post-op summary + cost delta within 24h after rehearsal. Ping here for any blockers. :thumbsup:
